description: This file defines classes and structures used for creating and configuring dialogs in the CKEditor, including dialog definitions, content pages, buttons, and UI elements. It provides a set of prototypical classes (not actual constructors) with documented properties to be used for defining dialogs through configuration objects.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.dialogDefinition
classes.description: Defines the properties and configuration for a dialog, including title, size, contents, buttons, and event handlers.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.contentDefinition
classes.description: Defines a content page within a dialog, including its identifier, label, access key, and UI elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.buttonDefinition
classes.description: Defines a button within a dialog, including label, action, access key, and state.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.uiElementDefinition
classes.description: Defines a UI element within a dialog content page, including type, id, styling, and lifecycle event handlers.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.add
methods.description: Registers a new dialog with a name and a factory function that returns its configuration object.
